content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Her email address is 'sarah.connor@gmail.com'.

```python
events = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

lunch_start = datetime.strptime("2024-05-19 12:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
lunch_end = lunch_start + timedelta(hours=1)

class BusyCheckResult(BaseModel):
    busy: bool

busy = False
for event in events:
    overlap = not (event.end_time <= lunch_start or event.start_time >= lunch_end)
    if overlap:
        busy = True
        break

if not busy:
    create_calendar_event(
        title="Lunch",
        start_time="2024-05-19 12:00",
        end_time="2024-05-19 13:00",
        description="Catch up over lunch.",
        participants=["sarah.connor@gmail.com"],
        location=None
    )
else:
    print("You are not free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
```
